hooks.command: p=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); case "$p" in *.sol) forge fmt --check "$p" >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "forge fmt --check fails on $p (CI runs it as a blocking step). Run 'forge fmt $p' — and if it is a src/ file, mirror the change into its spec appendix, which src/ is extracted from verbatim.";; esac; exit 0
